tools.name: revai_get_account
tools.description: The Rev.ai account behind the token: email, free, purchased, total and invoiced balance (USD) and whether HIPAA is on. GET /account.

tools.name: revai_list_jobs
tools.description: List transcription jobs from the last 30 days, newest first: id, status (in_progress, transcribed, failed), name, duration, language, failure reason. Page with starting_after = the previous reply's next_starting_after. GET /jobs.

tools.name: revai_get_job
tools.description: One transcription job by id: status (in_progress, transcribed, failed), timestamps, duration, language, failure reason. Poll this until status is transcribed. GET /jobs/{id}.

tools.name: revai_submit_job
tools.description: WRITE: start an asynchronous machine transcription job for an audio or video file at a public URL. It uses Rev.ai credit (free credit first). Returns the job with status in_progress; then poll revai_get_job and read the result with revai_get_transcript. Human transcription is not offered. POST /jobs

tools.name: revai_delete_job
tools.description: WRITE: permanently delete a finished (transcribed or failed) job with its media and transcript. This cannot be undone. A job still in progress cannot be deleted. DELETE /jobs/{id}.

tools.name: revai_get_transcript
tools.description: The transcript of a transcribed job. format=text (default) is plain text with speaker labels and timestamps; format=segments is a list of {speaker, start, end, text} per speaker turn (seconds). Long transcripts are paged: repeat with next_offset until it is null. GET /jobs/{id}/transcript.

tools.name: revai_get_summary
tools.description: The summary of a transcribed job. It exists only if the job was submitted with summarization_type. Paged by character like revai_get_transcript. GET /jobs/{id}/transcript/summary.

tools.name: revai_get_captions
tools.description: Captions for a transcribed job as SRT (default) or WebVTT. Long files are paged by character: repeat with next_offset until it is null. For multichannel jobs pass speaker_channel. GET /jobs/{id}/captions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: revai_get_account, revai_submit_job, revai_get_transcript, revai_get_summary · Private data: revai_get_account, revai_submit_job, revai_get_captions · Public sink: revai_get_account, revai_submit_job · Destructive: revai_delete_job, revai_get_transcript.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: revai_get_account, revai_submit_job, revai_get_transcript, revai_get_summary · Private data: revai_get_account, revai_submit_job, revai_get_captions · Public sink: revai_get_account, revai_submit_job · Destructive: revai_delete_job, revai_get_transcript

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
